release-channel private-preview
release-claim local-checker-backed-slice
publication-ready false
runtime 0.1.0-alpha.1
language 0.1-design
bytecode unavailable (none)
standard-library 0.1.0-alpha.1 (bounded-preview; alpha-source)

host Darwin/arm64
targets native-host
available-commands build check doctor fmt help init run test version
staged-commands add audit bench doc exec explain fix fuzz generate list outdated remove update vendor vet why

workload_manifest.measurement: Process wall time includes input construction, workload, checksum, startup and teardown. Native compilation excluded; VM includes source loading/checking/lowering.
limitations: No general Unicode lower/casefold API: normalize-title measures a shared corpus folding helper only.
No I/O, concurrency, JSON or HTTP claims.
Allocation workloads prescribe escaping objects; allocation counts, GC pauses and peak RSS are not measured.
Map/set implementations retain host ordering, hashing, growth and GC policies. Cross-language equality is observable results, not identical runtime layouts.
Go uses *Book and Rust Rc<Book> to preserve Marimay reference identity; Rust Rc costs do not generalize to all Rust representations.
BFS has fixed degree 16 and contiguous IDs; it is not an O(V²)-edge dense graph and record edges are IDs, not object pointers.

workloads.description: Linear exact UTF-8 title search; 75% hits and 25% misses.
Same queries over 100,000 unique runtime-built titles.
ASCII trim, owned scalar pieces, explicit ASCII/Russian folding table, builder, equality.
Four-token Russian/ASCII lines; owned token split and map counts; all keys checked.
Build 10k formatted rows using a growing string builder; checksum every UTF-8 byte.
Same rows with a fresh immutable concatenation each step (quadratic copy volume).
4096 integer keys, get then put; deterministic permutation and full weighted histogram.
Same map trace with dynamic Russian/ASCII title keys; fresh equal keys for final lookups.
Dynamic string keys to Book references; construct once, lookup and read title/state/serial.
Sliding live window; remove old string, check absence, insert fresh key; verify final membership.
BookState enum + exhaustive match; Go tagged struct + switch, Rust enum + match.
Concrete Book label call; no per-call result string allocation.
Materialized interface array; method-table call and UTF-8 label length.
Retain aliases in a growing array; compare every identity and read fields.
Retain fresh Book objects per batch; same fields, distinct identity; titles/states shared.
Append integers from empty capacity, then checksum all values.
Same append trace with one initial reserve.
Contiguous integer IDs, growing integer queue, distance array, degree 16.
Same edges/distances; Node records and reference queue; edges remain integer IDs.
Combined title search, title frequency map, and BookState match; 25% missing queries.
Format/parse decimal tokens, 25% invalid suffixes; propagate Result/error then match.
